name: codex-workflow-skills
description: Guided workflow intake, bounded councils, adversarial review, session knowledge closeout, and multi-perspective resume review skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Guided intake, councils, review loops, and knowledge closeout.
interface.longDescription: Codex Workflow Skills adds reusable skills for workflow routing, scoped intake, bounded multi-agent councils, evidence-based adversarial review, verified project and personal-wiki closeout, and independent recruiter, hiring-manager, and teammate resume evaluation.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow to route my request to intake or review.
Use $workflow-intake to scope this task before implementation.
Use $council to show options for reviewing and refining the current proposal.
Use $session-wiki to show closeout options for the current session.
Use $adversarial-review-loop to review this plan or diff.
Use $resume-multi-review to evaluate and revise my authoritative resume through three independent hiring lenses.
